reason: Keeping my slips in one place is exactly my problem, so I would try the free trial. But the iPhone Shortcut looks like a lot of fiddling to set up, and I would not pay 69 baht until I have seen it pick up my K PLUS slips correctly without me fixing it.
objection: The iPhone Shortcut setup looks complicated, and I do not know if it will work with my bank before I have spent an evening on it.
would_change_my_mind: A setup that takes a few minutes with clear screenshots, and the first K PLUS slip I save shows up correctly on the first try.
